slides.title: Inaugural Welcome & Dignitary Felicitations
slides.content: Official Portal Launch of ICETICT-2027 | Smart Class Room, Block - I, DRIEMS University
slides.speaker: AIRA (AI Anchor)
slides.speech: A very good morning to all our distinguished dignitaries, respected faculty members, and dear colleagues. Systems online, and ready to begin. On this momentous occasion, I have the distinct privilege of welcoming our esteemed leaders: our respected Vice Chancellor, Prof. (Dr.) Gopal Krishna Nayak sir; our respected Pro Vice Chancellor, Prof. (Dr.) Ramakanta Panigrahi sir; our respected Director, Administration, Sj. Balaram Kar sir; our esteemed Director, Coordination, Mrs. Chinmayee Rath ma'am; our Dean, School of Engineering and Technology, Prof. (Dr.) Nayan Ranjan Samal sir; our Associate Dean and Director IQAC, Prof. (Dr.) Alok Ranjan Biswal sir; and our Dean Research, Prof. (Dr.) Biswaranjan Mohanty sir. We also extend our heartfelt greetings to our esteemed Convenor, Dr. Amiya Kumar Sahoo, Head of the Department of Computer Science and Engineering; our dynamic Co-Convenors, Dr. Bajra Panjar Mishra, Assistant Professor in the Department of Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering, and Dr. Debayani Mishra, Assistant Professor in the Department of Electrical Engineering; our distinguished guests; all the respected Heads of Departments of the School of Engineering and Technology; and all our respected faculty members of the School of Engineering and Technology. Today, we gather for the official portal launch of ICETICT-2027 — the 2nd International Conference on Emerging Trends in Intelligent Computing Techniques, organized by the School of Engineering and Technology, DRIEMS University, in association with the IEEE Bhubaneswar Section, under IEEE Conference Record Number 72666, indexed by Scopus. Taking place in hybrid mode on July 16th and 17th, 2027, ICETICT provides a global multidisciplinary forum for scientists, academicians, and researchers to share groundbreaking innovations in intelligent computing. And now, to mark this auspicious milestone and launch our official portal to the world, I most respectfully invite all our esteemed dignitaries to the stage to do the honors of unveiling the official conference website. Respected dignitaries, please do the honors of unveiling the portal. Three... Two... One...
